title: agreement (fovariant-2)

freshResult.formula: Exists q0: cylinder. Exists q1: cylinder. Forall q2: cube. right(q1,q2) AND right(q2,q0)

referenceResult.formula: Exists q0: cylinder. Exists q1: cylinder. Forall q2: cube. left(q0,q2) AND left(q2,q1)

intendedConcept: For every cylinder there is a sphere to the left of it and to the right of it.
